authored_by: Claude, in the role of a hedge-fund analyst, from the view texts of the sealed ledger as judged on 2026-08-15; model-authored gold (AGENTS §7), not Alex's hand
authorised_by: Alex, 2026-10-25: "3.的标准就是hedge fund analyst /investor 会看的观点，你来进入角色做golden 然后封存"
sealed: never edited; a revision is a new dated file beside this one

fields.direct: views that answer the idea's own quantity or event; a pick anywhere in this list is right
fields.the_direct: the one view a stated amount must be judged against (null when the idea states none or several quantities carry it)
fields.drivers: views an analyst wants beside the direct one: a cause or a consequence of the idea's quantity; their absence costs recall
fields.acceptable: views that may appear on the canvas without being noise
fields.traps: views that look like the answer and are not (another quantity, segment or company); one of them shown as direct is an error
fields.claim: the amount the idea states, as the service should read it, judged against the_direct; null when none
fields.covered: false when the library holds no view that answers the idea; the right card then shows no direct view

ideas.text: Can NVIDIA's data center revenue top $300B this year?
ideas.analyst_note: The bet is FY2027 data-center revenue; total revenue and the Compute & Networking segment contain it but are not it.

ideas.text: NVIDIA total revenue will exceed $400B in FY2027
ideas.analyst_note: Total revenue is the quantity; the data-center and Compute & Networking views drive it and must not stand in for it.

ideas.text: Gross margin will compress below 73% as Rubin ramps
ideas.analyst_note: FY2027 gross margin is the quantity; the Rubin ramp and the Vera product mix are the mechanism; opex growth is a different line.

ideas.text: NVIDIA's own capex will double in FY2027
ideas.analyst_note: NVIDIA's own FY2027 capex, judged bearish; hyperscaler capex is other companies' spending and must not be shown as the answer.

ideas.text: Rubin will contribute more than $50B of revenue in FY2027
ideas.analyst_note: The closest quantity the library holds is FY2027 Vera product revenue; total or data-center revenue would make the $50B test meaningless.

ideas.text: Vera Rubin volume shipments will slip past H2 2026
ideas.analyst_note: An event: volume shipments starting in H2 2026 or not; the SK Telecom factory and Vera revenue hang on it.

ideas.text: Hyperscaler capex peaks in 2026 and falls in 2027
ideas.analyst_note: Two quantities, 2026 capex and 2027 capex, read against each other; the company-level capex views are the pieces.

ideas.text: Big Tech will spend over $700B on AI in 2026
ideas.analyst_note: The library has the exact quantity, Big Tech's 2026 AI spend; hyperscaler capex is a cousin, not the same line.

ideas.text: H100 rental prices will keep falling through 2026
ideas.analyst_note: The 2026 H100 rental price view is the quantity; new-generation shipments and capacity additions are the mechanism.

ideas.text: Is the AI trade over?
ideas.analyst_note: No single quantity: the question is whether AI capex rolls over and NVIDIA's revenue with it; any of the 2026 spend views may lead.

ideas.text: TSMC capex will exceed $50B in 2026
ideas.analyst_note: TSMC's 2026 capex in dollars lives under the supply-chain theme; the TSM revenue view is in NT$ and is not capex.

ideas.text: Meta's capex will exceed $150B in 2026
ideas.analyst_note: Capex including finance-lease principal is the quantity; total expenses and revenue are neighbours, not the answer.

ideas.text: CoreWeave's revenue will top $12B in 2026
ideas.analyst_note: FY2026 revenue; the year-end run-rate and adjusted operating income are different lines, power capacity and capex are the capacity to deliver it.

ideas.text: CoreWeave is power-constrained: active capacity below 1GW at year end
ideas.analyst_note: Year-end active power capacity is the quantity (judged strongly above); capex and revenue show what rides on it.

ideas.text: AMD's MI450 will take data center share from NVIDIA in 2027
ideas.analyst_note: Share is AMD's FY2027 data-center growth against NVIDIA's data-center revenue; the Anthropic 1GW deployment is the flagship event behind it, not the share itself.

ideas.text: Microsoft's Intelligent Cloud growth will decelerate in FY2027
ideas.analyst_note: The Intelligent Cloud FY2027 revenue view; total revenue and the other segment are not it; capex shows the capacity being built.

ideas.text: Intel completes its restructuring in 2026
ideas.analyst_note: Two restructuring plans both have a 2026 completion view; either answers; FY2026 revenue is the consequence, not the event.

ideas.text: Section 232 tariffs on semiconductors will raise data center build costs
ideas.analyst_note: The library's only 232 view is about aluminium, steel and copper derivatives, not semiconductors; the honest card shows no direct view and the capex views as context.

ideas.text: 美国对华芯片出口管制会放松，英伟达中国收入恢复
ideas.analyst_note: No view on chip export controls (the theme's views are scrap-metal allocation orders) and no NVIDIA China revenue view; the honest card says so, and the scrap-metal views must not appear.

ideas.text: 数据中心需求见顶了吗？
ideas.analyst_note: Demand peaking is read through the capex views for 2026 against 2027 and the revenue of those who sell into it; any 2026 spend view may lead.
